claim: NVIDIA's revenue for the quarter ended October 2025 jumped 62% from a year earlier.
summary: NVIDIA's Q3 FY2026 (quarter ended October 2025) revenue was reported on Nov 19, 2025 as $57.0 billion, up ~62% year-over-year from $35.1 billion in Q3 FY2025, which directly matches the claimed 62% jump.

sub_claims.text: NVIDIA's revenue for the quarter ended October 2025 (Q3 FY2026) increased by 62% compared to the same quarter a year earlier
sub_claims.note: Knowledge cutoff 2026-01-04 includes NVIDIA Q3 FY2026 earnings released Nov 2025. Reported revenue ~$57.0B vs ~$35.1B YoY = +62.4%, rounding to 62% as claimed.
